_note: Phase success metrics (eval/diagnostics/phase_success.py). Always computed on this PC's CPU (one platform; JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, parallel launcher), so values here are compared only with each other. Modes: deterministic (mean motion, gripper logit > 0) and gripper_sampled (mean motion, gripper Bernoulli with the fixed keys; l2.rollout mode 2). The L1 reference brain has a scripted gripper: its gripper_sampled entry equals the deterministic one.
